properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.7 is really pinned in package-lock.json (declared at lines 841, 864, 2815, 3926 — a transitive dependency of elliptic and the web3/browserify stack). properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: secp256k1@^4.0.1 with @types/secp256k1@^4.0.1 is a real transitive dependency of the web3.js stack (pulled by ethereum-cryptography/web3), pinned at package-lock.json:7606 ("node_modules/secp256k1", resolved 4.0.2). The build ships secp256k1 ECDSA signing — the standard blockchain signing curve. No direct call site in this application: it only decodes on-chain sale events via ABI. Changeable here by upgrading web3/deps; the algorithm itself is quantum-unsafe (ML-DSA-65 migr
